{{Header Nav|game=Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas}}
The following table lists every mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. In boxes with multiple missions, the missions must be completed in that order. The first (or only) mission in each box becomes available once the missions above it are finished. For example, ''Drive-By'' and ''OG Loc'' are available after ''Nines and AK's'' is completed, and ''Doberman'' requires ''Cesar Vialpando'' and ''Burning Desire''.

There are several missions made available at different points that are not required for storyline advancement. These are not shown.

After the ending cutscene of ''The Green Sabre'', the player will appear in the southwest corner of San Fierro. The bridges between San Fierro and Los Santos will now be open.

== Las Venturas ==
''Monster'' is triggered by a telephone call. Following the call, the mission destination will be in northwest Las Venturas. The bridges connecting Las Venturas to San Fierro and Los Santos are now open. Freight missions are now unlocked.
